name: Tankbustas
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 1st to 2nd unit 160 pts for 6 models; 3rd+ unit 170 pts for 6 models.
_composition_note: Printed as: 1 Nob model, 5 Tankbusta models. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_loadout: The Nob is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 2 Rokkit Pistol. Every Tankbusta is equipped with: 1 Busta Rokkit Launcha; 1 Gitstikka.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.

_wargearOptions_note: Printed as: The Nob can have their Rokkit Pistol replaced with 1 Smash Hammer. | 1 Tankbusta model can be equipped with one of the following: ~ 1 Busta Rokkit Launcha ~ 1 Pulsa Rokkit The Nob starts with 2 Rokkit Pistols and the option is read as swapping one of them for the Smash Hammer. The Tankbusta option is an add-on: an extra Busta Rokkit Launcha on top of the one he carries, or the Pulsa Rokkit wargear.
